_approach: The Japanese branch of the scene (hyperflip, tracing back to Niconico's otoMAD remix culture per Wikipedia) tends toward busier, more rhythmically ornate anime/J-pop/Vocaloid flips than the US dariacore lineage. This groove uses a rolling triplet-feel hat and clave pattern (swing 0.33) reminiscent of the ornamental fills common in Vocaloid-adjacent production, over a breakbeat-derived kick — a construction approach distinct from the straight-16th US grooves above. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
